title: F. Kosuke's Sloth
statement:
Kosuke is too lazy. He will not give you any legend, just the task:

Fibonacci numbers are defined as follows:

As this number can be too big, output it by modulo 10^9+7.

For example: G(3,2)=9 because the 3-rd Fibonacci number that is divisible by 2 is 34. [1,1,textbf2,3,5,textbf8,13,21,textbf34].

The first line of the input data contains a single integer t (1 ≤ t ≤ 10^4) — the number of test cases.

The first and only line contains two integers n and k (1 ≤ n ≤ 10^18, 1 ≤ k ≤ 10^5).

It is guaranteed that the sum of k across all test cases does not exceed 10^6.

For each test case, output the only number: the value G(n,k) taken by modulo 10^9+7.

Input:
```
33 2100 11000000000000 1377
```

Output:
```
9
100
999244007
```
